lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Densely packed high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns on the anterior-lateral flank, with increasing spatial distance between centroids toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with high-luminance circular blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from bright dorsal pixels to dark ventral pixels, indicating structural ridges.
